notes: A RULING RELABEL. Batch b01 of the DCL13-C tier-B census (tier-B rows for lua, mbedtls, mosquitto, pureftpd and hostap); tier B is FP rows whose recorded reason rests on a public API/ABI signature or contract with no callback wording, ruled strict TP unless the function writes *p. Brandon's 2026-09-29 DCL13-C rulings: a signature, callback or function-pointer-slot constraint is not an exception (option (c)): a function whose non-const pointer parameter is fixed by a function-pointer slot it is visibly assigned to is TP with provenance tag `oracle-tag: interface-fixed signature: fn-pointer slot` (the relaxed profile scores it FP); const is shallow as in C, so a write through a pointer member of *p is not a write to *p, while an array or nested-struct member write is. Each row was re-derived by reading the pinned source: FP only where the function writes *p directly, through a local alias, by passing p (or &p->m, or an array member) to a function or macro whose parameter is pointer-to-non-const or cannot be resolved, or by storing p itself into an object that outlives the call; otherwise TP, tagged where the function's name is assigned to a function-pointer object, table entry or function-pointer parameter in the pinned source. A key with several flagged parameters is TP if at least one is unmodified; its reason names each. Keys aurora-lint 44af4205 no longer reports at the line were relabeled on the parameter the prior reason discussed (provenance says so). 4 row(s) were left out and listed for the coordinator (not a parameter of a function definition, or a pointee of function type). 11 TP rows carry the tag; 17 rows stay FP, their reasons restated on a write basis. Blind slice: 20 seeded rows (seed 18921) re-labeled by a fresh reader without the prior verdict or reason; 0 of 20 disagreed. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here. basis: ruling. selection: census (every in-scope DCL13-C FP row whose recorded reason matches the tier-B signature/API/ABI predicate and not the tier-A callback predicate; this batch covers tier-B rows for lua, mbedtls, mosquitto, pureftpd and hostap). reviewed: 154. flipped: 137 (FP -> TP). blind_to_prior: false. blind_to_diagnostic: false.
